summary.status: all stored hosts exactly admissible; scores are floating diagnostics only
summary.interpretation: Only canonical individual-cycle coefficients were searched. This run did not search complete two-cover or target defects. No sign theorem follows from absence of a negative coefficient. The starting_ratio optimization field is the score of its selected exact integer seed; zeros in that seed were replaced by 1e-4 before logarithms, and the optimizer enforced the stated [-9,9] bounds.
